name: Dry brown wilted fall 095
modifier: a long straightish run with two sharp kinks
prompt: ONE long climbing vine SNAKING and WINDING across a rock face, clinging tight to the stone as it climbs, coiling in slow curves the way a creeper spirals a tree trunk, gripping tendrils along its length, dense clusters of jungle leaves sprouting at points on the vine with bare woody stem between them, the plant's roots far below out of sight, jungle-lush and alive, fantasy RPG nature art, no straight edges, no border, no rock or wall behind it, transparent background, dry brown wilted fall, a long straightish run with two sharp kinks, towering, many times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: moonlit silver shimmer across the leaves
